intro: Warden Thelwater seals a report about a visitor to Bazil Thredd in the Stormwind Stockade. The confidential account helps track a covert operative moving through Stormwind's political and criminal spheres.

p: Prisoner Bazil Thredd spent years in the Stockade without a visitor. Then a quiet man began coming once or twice each week, carrying valid identification papers under the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater took note of the unusual visits and wrote down the man's appearance. He sealed the description so no meddling eyes could read it before proper investigators acted.
